sloka: वलीमुखं प्रजङ्घं च सन्नादं च महाबलम् ।दरीमुखं दधिमुखमिन्द्रजानुं च यूथपम् ।। ७.३९.२२ ॥
transliteration: valīmukhaṁ prajaṅghaṁ ca sannādaṁ ca mahābalam ।darīmukhaṁ dadhimukhamindrajānuṁ ca yūthapam ।। 7.39.22 ॥

translations.english: This verse lists the names of several prominent monkey chiefs: Valimukha, Prajangha, the mighty Sannada, Darimukha, Dadhimukha, and Indrajānu, who were all leaders of troops.
